Statuses: confirmed (NHRA + 2 others), three_sources_not_nhra, two_sources_agree (second-pass rule), nhra_only, disputed. hp null = rating withheld (fewer than two agreeing sources).
HP: advertised gross through 1971; SAE net from 1972 (Chevrolet printed both in 1971: 400/255 gross = 170 net, 402/300 = 206 net, 454/365 = 285 net).

Police: 9C1 police package moved from Impala to Caprice for 1986. Pre-1986 police 350s belong to the Impala and are excluded here. Police rows are separate where ratings differ from civilian engines; the 1994-96 LT1 police rating equals the civilian 260 hp.
1991-96: GM kits cover sedans only; wagon engines rest on EPA, Wikipedia and Hagerty.
2011-2017 Caprice PPV: US police-only (Holden-built). Not in NHRA or the EPA input file.
Excluded from Caprice: 1965 409s (Caprice package arrived mid-year after the 409 ended; Hagerty Caprice configs omit them), 1994-96 Impala SS (separate page).
